action: Publish a structured market brief titled 'Auto-Adjacent Commercial Property in Millfield: What the RoboRide Expansion Means for Owners, Investors, and Tenants.' Brief covers: (1) current vacancy trend data for dealerships, repair shops, and gas stations in the Millfield corridor, (2) projected demand compression over 18 months post-RoboRide Phase 2 deployment, (3) adaptive reuse case studies from Phase 1 cities — robotaxi staging lots, EV charging retail hybrid nodes, ghost kitchen conversions. Distributed to existing client list, posted to LinkedIn, submitted to Millfield Business Journal as guest analysis.
